name: Council permits for public spaces
what: Get a council permit to busk, film or put outdoor dining on footpaths and other public land, under each council's local laws.
consistency_note: Each council sets its own permits, conditions and fees; the register holds 7 councils so far.

basis.source: Busking permit council of the city of sydney
basis.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
basis.quote: You will need this permit if you intend to busk or perform other forms of entertainment in a public place.

basis.source: Busking or street entertaining permit city of melbourne
basis.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
basis.quote: You will require this permit if you intend to busk or perform street theatre or other forms of entertainment on a road or in a public place.

basis.source: Busker street performer permit brisbane city council
basis.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
basis.quote: You will need this permit to busk or provide entertainment in a public place for money or other type of reward.
